name: Begging
description: The self-abasing act of pleading, as a form of submission, being incorporated into an RP.

name: Chastity
description: Sexual abstinence, either willing or forced; this can include someone simply abstaining from sexual activity, or the wearing of a device that prevents it.

name: Coercion / Blackmail
description: Refers to the inclusion of Coercion and / or Blackmail in the context of the story arc of an RP, often in the form of a semi-consensual means of receiving goods, services, or sex from a partner.

name: Corruption
description: Refers to the loss of morality, characterized by a character starting pure and then becoming depraved in some way, typically ending with them being evil, slutty, or some combination of the two.

name: Degradation
description: A situation where one character will be purposefully degraded, usually as a means of lowering their self worth; typically in the context of guilt or BDSM.

name: Dirty Talking
description: The act of speaking in a typically explicit manner to provoke sexual stimulation from a participant, sometimes one's self; often in the context of seduction or foreplay.

name: Discipline / Reinforcement
description: The use of reinforcement (rewards and / or punishments) in order to train a submissive to obey the various commands of a master.

name: Extreme Humiliation
description: Engaging in an RP in which one character will purposefully be humiliated to the point (or attempted point) of intense, mental anguish and total loss of self-worth through sexual interaction; typically implies exceptional or devastating, psychological damage.

name: Fear
description: Refers to the incorporation of one or more character(s) having reason to be fearful during the sexual (or even nonsexual) aspects of an RP.

name: Femdom
description: Play in which a character of female gender takes the role of dominant, maintaining control and authority; being considered the focal point of the dynamic. It is defined as an exchange founded on her needs, pleasures, and desires, with the submissive’s purpose to provide service to her first and foremost.

name: Feminization
description: The act of changing the appearance of a male identifying character through traditionally realistic means to have them appear more feminine / female. Typically implies the use of makeup, feminine clothes / accessories, as well as possibly adopting more feminine mannerisms and behaviors.

name: Forced Incest
description: Engaging in an RP in which a character is forced to have sex with a character who is related to them, either by blood or marriage.

name: Forced Nudity
description: The act of either forcing a character to be nude or being forced to be nude by another character; typically used in public situations.

name: Force Feeding
description: Engaging in an RP in which a character, typically bound or otherwise immobile, is forced to consume large, often impossible and unrealistic, amounts of food against their will, often resulting in inflation and / or weight gain.

name: Humiliation
description: Engaging in an RP in which one character will be embarrassed, typically extremely and / or frequently, in an attempt to elicit either a response of sexual gratification from the emotions correlating to humiliation, or merely as a form of psychological domination or punishment; typically a more intense form of degradation.

name: Hypnotism / Mind Control
description: Engaging in an RP in which one character will mentally and / or supernaturally take control of another character's mind and / or body through psychic means or hypnotic means, sometimes through the use of supernatural or magical powers.

name: Impotence
description: Expresses an interest in characters that are unable to achieve an erection (or arousal) without, or even with, help.

name: Lima Syndrome
description: The act of a character that is an abductor developing sympathy for their captives, trusting and / or displaying affection for their captive / victim.

name: Master / Pet
description: Engaging in an RP in which a domination / submission relationship is played between at least two characters, and in which the bottom character takes on the role of a pet; typically a training-based scenario with positive reinforcement over negative reinforcement, as well as the inclusion of affection.

name: Master / Slave
description: Engaging in an RP in which a domination / submission relationship is played between at least two characters, and in which the bottom character takes on the role of a slave; typically requires the slave to accept any and all commands, often involves non-sexual forms of abuse and uses negative reinforcement.

name: Mental Torture
description: An expressed interest in scenes that involve torture that is psychological in nature, typically involving themes of fear, paranoia, insanity, mental abuse, and so on.

name: Objectification
description: The act of either being treated or treating another character as a specific and set object, often articles of furniture, or bestowing dehumanizing tasks to a character in order to imbue a character with the traits of an object.

name: Orientation Play
description: Expresses an interest in RP's in which one character's sexual orientation will be a focal point of the scene, typically in correlation with the discovery, exploration, or coercion of bisexuality / homosexuality in the sexuality of a character.

name: Physical Restraints
description: The act of giving or receiving commands, typically verbal, that limit the way in which another character is permitted to physically interact with another character.

name: Possessiveness / Jealousy
description: Describes a character who is or becomes jealous or even possessive of their partner(s). Such a character may be (overly) demanding and overbearing in a relationship, growing aggressive towards those that may encroach on said partner.

name: Powerbottoming
description: An expressed interest in a sexual exchange where the character who is receiving penetration is in control, dominant, taking initiative, or directing the interaction.

name: Public Humiliation
description: One or more characters engaging in explicit and elicit, sexual activity in a public setting for the purposes of humiliating one or more characters.

name: Puppy / Pony Play
description: Engaging in an RP in which a domination / submission relationship is played between two characters, and in which the bottom character takes on the role and psyche of a feral puppy, pony, or other predetermined animal; typically involves rituals, speech restrictions, physical restrictions, and humiliation, as well as extensive training and a mixture of positive and negative reinforcement.

name: Sexual Restraints
description: Refers to a dominant giving a command for how the submissive may act in regard to sexual acts or within a sexual situation; often a decree of chastity or prohibition from any form of sexual contact.

name: Speech Restrictions
description: The act of giving or receiving commands, typically verbal, that limit the way in which another character is permitted to speak or otherwise make noise from one's mouth; typically used in a BDSM context to constrain the submissive to begging, animal noises or silence.

name: Stockholm Syndrome
description: The act of a character trusting or displaying affection towards those responsible for kidnapping / taking them as a hostage, may or may not involve actual kidnapping vs. a domestic abuse relationship.

name: Uppity
description: Expresses an interest in engaging in an RP in which the submissive and / or bottom character is combative and disobedient in any number of ways.

name: Verbal Abuse
description: The act of verbally accosting or being verbally accosted with derogatory terms pertaining to sex, or in the effort to demean, degrade or otherwise humiliate another character, or occasionally to elicit sexual stimulation from abuse.

name: Being Dominant
description: Taking the lead and control.

name: Being Submissive
description: Handing over control.

name: Switching
description: Moving between dominant and submissive roles.

name: Service Submission
description: Submission through acts of service.

name: Obedience Training
description: Training one's partners to follow commands.

name: Brat / Brat-Taming
description: Taming/putting a brat in their place.

name: Praise
description: Warm, dirty-talk-adjacent praise mid-scene.

name: Edging
description: Repeatedly nearing orgasm without release.
